fields.description: Verso pairs smaller apartments with two larger four-bedroom homes in Meydan Horizon. Shared spaces bring swimming, padel and quieter outdoor activity into the same building.

sources.label: Verso and Époque: developer launch, 2 October 2026

overview: Compare the different balconies as carefully as the internal rooms.
research.locationNote: The developer places Verso in Meydan Horizon, Dubai. Property Finder uses Meydan; EZRE uses the broader Bukadra label.
research.priceNote: Property Finder gives an AED 1.6 million launch guide, with larger layouts priced separately. No dated primary price list or current selected-home quotation was verified.
research.paymentNote: The reference table follows Property Finder’s 20 / 10 / 70 schedule. EZRE also lists 30 / 70 alternatives. No original dated payment document was verified; confirm the applicable instalment triggers and discount conditions.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder targets December 2029; EZRE gives Q4 2029. These are secondary forecasts, not a verified contractual date or completion certificate.
